name: brain
description: Query, check and report on the Markdown notes in a brain folder.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run size
scripts.gates: f=0; npm test || f=1; npm run check || f=1; npm run privacy || f=1; for d in web/app web/worker design-system; do npm --prefix $d run typecheck || f=1; done; npm --prefix web/app test || f=1; npm --prefix web/app run lint || f=1; npm --prefix web/worker test || f=1; npm --prefix web/worker run lint || f=1; exit $f
